blocks.text: THE WHORING OF AHOLAH AND AHOLIBAH AND THE WICKENDNESS OF JUDA AND ISRAEL— “These two women are used to type Samaria and Jerusalem and the lewd sins of Israel and it is also a figure of Rev. 17:5.- All this will be represented again in the future in this apostate system! This chapter reveals fornication with idol worship and also literal fornication and whoredoms of the flesh.” (Ezek. 23:1-2) “The Word of the Lord came saying Son of man there were two women the daughters of one mother. Verse 3, “shows the beginning of their loose and flaunting sins!” Verse 5, “And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine, and she “doted” on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors! (‘Doted’ means to love to extreme excesses)! ‘Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses. Verse 7, Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, the chosen men with all on whom she doted: With all their idols she defiled herself! Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt, for in her youth they lay with her and they bruised the breast of her virginity and poured their whoredom upon her! This same kind of idol madness in fornication will repeat again in the anti-christ system!” Rev. 18:2, “The habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird! Also strange and weird acts of sex perversion are associated to idol worship!”’ — Verse 11, “reveals her sister Aholibah was more corrupt in her inordinate love than her sister. ‘Verse 14 speaks about images being portrayed before them! Verse 15 reveals their attire in the manner of the Babylonians!” Verse 16, “And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted (loved) upon them and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea! “This reminds us of the modern sex dances where they stand before each other in doting!” Verse 17, “And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love and they defiled her with their whoredoms and she was polluted with them! This means she mixed with the children of Babel (Nimrod’s seed)! — (For total understanding read all Ezek., chap. 23, after reading this Script as time permits).

THE INCREASE OF HER DEBAUCHERY AND INSAT- IABLE DESIRES— orgies — idols and depravity — (Ezek. 23) Verse 20, ‘For she doted upon their paramours, (lovers) whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses (genitals).” The original Hebrew translation renders this insight, “And their lust like the lust of horses”!) — “They were taken over by intense lust and torment of nymphomania for leaving the Lord for idols; It will happen to the modern church age at the end! Also remember the horrible cloud of sin that fell upon Solomon’s activities will repeat!” (I Kings 11:4-8) — “When idols are introduced people become demonic, consumating into the most vulgar display before their images in incoherent stupers. — “‘Also it is reported that some U.S.A. stores are selling pendant “Smages” for each sign of the Zodiac which is worn around the neck. And on the pendant it shows the human forms in perversive acts 12 different ways! So the person who wears one reveals to the other person his or her certain way in evil desires!”” — “Verses 37-39 reveals they passed their children through the fire devouring them and that they had slain their children to their idols! Then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it, lo in the midst of mine house!” — “It definitely reveals to us the wickedness which will occur soon and maturing worse during the Tribulation! The anti-christ will be a mixture of all perversions!” Dan. 9:27, “describes his activities. Now we take this rendering from the original Hebrew translation. This speaks of the covenant, and in the middle of the week, he will make the sacrifice and the offering to cease. and the loathsome brute will desolate to the extreme!” — Dan. 11:31-32 “And he will defile the sanctuary and they will abolish the perpetual sacrifice establishing the desolating brute! Which means the same as abomination of desolation! (idols). Read Mark 13:14, standing were it ought not!”

EZEK. Chap. 23 — THE AGE CLOSING OUT AND THE DESOLATIONS OF BABYLON — “In order to get a complete view of this we will take it directly from the Hebrew translation. Verses 40-44, “And in spite of all that, you have sent for men to come from a distance, to whom you have sent a messenger, and they came. Then you bathed, painted your eyes, and decked yourself with jewels for them, and sat on a splendid couch, with a table spread before it, and my oil and perfumes upon it! And the sound of luxury was with her, — and with the mob of men, — ‘men from the west’, — drunkards from the desert, on whose hands she put jewels, and beautiful turbans on their heads! Then I remarked, Will they commit adultery with the old woman! Will they fornicate with the worn-out prostitute! And they went to her as they go to a woman who is a whore!” — “Yes, saith the Lord the young Laodicean church system and harlot false protestants will go back to the old whore! (Rev. 17:4-5) — Remember Jezebel and her 400 false prophets are like today’s hundreds of protestant organizational heads returning and joined unto her!” “The above Scriptures give us the exact religious setting for the end” Ezek. 23:46-49, “reveals the wrath of God and judgment is poured out upon the two women! Verse 48 reveals a lesson that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness and sins of your idols!”

THE ANTI-CHRIST WILL BE IN THE CENTER AND JOINED TO ALL OF THIS ABOMINATION— “And in association to this Scripture (And we take this directly from the original Greek rendering) II Thess. 2:3-4, Let no one cheat you by any such means! For the apostasy must come first, and the man of lawlessness, the son of destruction, must first be revealed; the one who withstands, and is self-exalted over and above all that is called Divine, or worshipped; so that he seats himself in the sanctuary of God, proclaiming that he himself is God!” Verses 7-8, For the mystery of that lawlessness already operates; only the Restrainer intervenes for a time: until he is removed. (“Means the Holy Spirit is reserved aside and the elect is taken out!) And then the outlaw will become manifest whom the Lord will destroy by the spirit of His mouth!” Verse 9, “This outlaw’s arrival will be accompanied by the energy of satan! With all powers, and signs, and terrors of falsehood! — “The man of sin is soon to reveal himself!”

PROV. 7:5-27 AMONG OTHER THINGS IS AN EXACT TYPE OF THE EVIL CHURCH WOMAN’S SYSTEM ENDING THE AGE— Babylon harlot. We will compare Scripture to Scripture, Verse 7, “I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding! (Empty vessel). Verse 9, “In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night! And behold there met him a woman with the attire of a harlot and subtil of heart”. (Rev. 17:4-5, arrayed in purple and scarlet.) Verses 11-21, She is loud and stubborn, her feet abide not in her house, now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner (church organizations). So she caught him and kissed him and with impudent face said unto him, I have peace offerings with me; this day have I paid my vows (sounds like mass or paying for sins). It reveals she diligently went forth to seek his face and found him! (The harlot church seeking and bringing back the protestants. “The next verse reveals how her bed was decked with coverings, perfumes, aloes, myrrh and cinnamon! (Rev. 17:4, “Rev. 18:12”) Prov. 7 verse 18, ‘Come let us take our fill of love until the morning. The (next verse) “for the good man is not at home, he has gone on a long journey and will come home at the day appointed!” This reference is exactly like the New Testament Scripture of Christ going and returning back!) — Verse 21, “With her much fair speech she caused him to yield and with flattering of her lips she forced him! (Rev. 2:20, “reveals, Jezebel seducing my servants to commit fornication! Concerning decked bed, Rev. 2:22, “I will cast her into a bed and them that commit adultery with her into Great Tribulation! By Babylon’s fair speech she will seduce the lukewarm protestants’. — “Read the whole Prov. Ch. 7 and the rest of the verses”. — “Words of wisdom, Verses 24-26. “Let not thine heart decline to her ways (doctrines), go not astray in her paths (systems) for she has cast down many (spiritually wounded)! Yea, many strong men (Christians) have been slain by her.” (Babylon) Verse 27, Her house (apostate system) is a way to hell, going down to the chambers of death!
